decisions.reason: Merges the opening into natural English while keeping the spread wings cutting the wind.

눈에 들어왔다 is the room coming into view, not the narrator taking it in.
Preserves 영혼 없는 and 던지고; SOL turns soulless into insincere and overstates 자연스럽다.
Naturalizes the 하루 이틀이야 idiom as ‘is this anything new.’

decisions.replacement: By the time I came to my senses, it was all over. Jinho hyung stared blankly at me as I licked the pot clean.

decisions.reason: 태어나서 is ‘in your life,’ which SOL weakens to ‘before.’

설마 is ‘don’t tell me,’ not ‘wait, is this.’
Keeps the second-person 넣어 둔다고 jab SOL recasts as a generic who-throws-out.
The doubled 처음에는 belongs in this paragraph.
An extra paragraph break overstates the source’s same-paragraph fragment.
Same model/manufacturer question in more spoken English.

decisions.replacement: On the related sites, he was a named user people knew by name alone. He’d even run an IT blog.

decisions.reason: 즉각 튀어나온 대답 condenses without losing the crash of expectations.
Turned anything up / turned up anything are equal.
개조 as modded fits Jinho’s register; modified is stiffer.
들을수록 암담하다 is ‘the bleaker it got’; SOL adds ‘looked.’
그렇다 쳐 is I’ll grant you the design, not set it aside.
쌩 초면 is complete strangers; SOL explains it away.
제조사일 수도 is that it is an overseas manufacturer, not from one.
Same action and face; clause swap is not better.
한글로 만들 is making the manual in Korean, not producing a Korean manual.
그때 진호 형이 말했다 stays in this beat as ‘that was when.’
SOL’s ‘suddenly spoke’ adds 갑자기 the source does not have.
검색 중인 모양이다 is the observational fragment; SOL flattens it.
Singular site sets up 거기 / ‘that one was pretty good.’
유령 회사도 아니고 is an assertion, not a question.
Read the rest of it / the rest are equal; BASE keeps ‘of it.’
유령에 홀린 is being haunted, not seeing a ghost.
문과충 자식 as liberal-arts dumbass playing innocent is punchier speech.
Snatched and 그 내용 as contents are already faithful; SOL’s Everything is looser.
저 표정. 말투. is already a staccato line; extra paragraph is more pause than the source.
진심이다 belongs with the look and tone, not isolated.
Keep the look, tone, sincerity, and invisible writing as one beat.
이 내용은 is this, not a weaker it.
그렇게 굳어 있었다 is stayed frozen like that; SOL adds standing and drops 그렇게.
SOL makes the gloss cause the egg look; the source lists both traits.
Need 앉아 있던; 카운터에 is at the counter, not behind it.
decisions.replacement: Still half out of my mind, I answered the capsule café owner sitting at the counter.

decisions.reason: 접속자 is users; SOL’s full sentence is better than the BASE fragment.
decisions.replacement: The virtual-reality game he’d recommended was a megahit with ten million concurrent users. It had incredible graphics, outstanding freedom, and more than seventy percent of the market, he’d said.

decisions.reason: 그래픽을 보고 is looked at; SOL’s then/saw is looser and the game is already clear.
내가 미쳤나 answers 그래픽 미쳤죠; ‘the one who’ keeps the callback.
외모 is appearances, not faces; 느껴지는 is felt; 부자연스럽다 is was, not felt.
decisions.replacement: The NPCs’ appearances and movements, their dialogue patterns, the five senses I felt through my character—all of it was unnatural. It was a *game*, but it never felt like *reality*.

decisions.reason: 혼자 플레이하는 is single-player in this shop talk.
Tighter spoken match for 무협 게임 중에 그런 게 있어요.

Death-like silence is one sentence; don’t prefaced-split it.
죽음 같은 침묵이 흘렀다 is a deathly silence followed, not a second ‘dead silence.’
용건 is the curt ‘what’s your business,’ not a generic want.
Keeps 덕분에, 눈물샘, and 잠시나마 촉촉해졌던; SOL drops all three.
일부러 하지 않았다 is one clause; 울 것 같아서 supports probably.
컨디션 조절 실패 is failed condition management, not ‘off my game.’
decisions.replacement: I bombed the July mock exam. I failed to manage my condition and missed even the easy questions. God, the more I think about it, the more annoyed I get.

decisions.reason: 유전자 몰빵 is dumping all the genes into one kid, not hogging good genes.

decisions.replacement: Listening to my little sister chatter, I stood up. It was time to step out from beneath the old, rusted sign and go back to my room.
